title: Safehouse and Cipher
author: Rosalind Underhill
blurb: Rafael Marchetti, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
